name: enhance-hearing-look-three-decline-all-three-bottom
notes: Enhance Hearing (edg616r0za): a wind card is available as the 3rd looked-at card but the player declines the 'may reveal'. All three go to the bottom in their original order and nothing is stranded in the temp zone (the follow-up needed dontSkipOnPass).

rulesClauses: Look at the top three cards of your deck. You may reveal a wind element card or a Reaction card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated cardActivatedAbilities["edg616r0za:0"] body looked at the top three cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at (a wind or Reaction card deeper than the first card was never offered). Also the "may reveal" follow-up CUSTOM was added without dontSkipOnPass, so declining (PASS) skipped EnhanceHearingFinish and stranded the looked-at card in myTempZone. The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone() and dontSkipOnPass:1.
